heading: Over 70 Years of
Moving Pakistan
sectionOne.description: From a single truck in 1954 to a trusted third-party logistics provider, guided by one motto: "Professional Par Excellence".

sectionTwo.heading: A Legacy That Began With One Truck
paragraphs: Our legacy traces back to 1954 and the vision of Mr. Abdul Rahim, who started with a single truck and went on to establish Taj Transport Company. That modest beginning grew into Mehran Tankers, a name synonymous with reliability in Pakistan’s transport industry.

Building on this foundation, Mr. Abdul Wahab established Logistics Management International (LMI) in July 2005, structuring the company around fresh thinking, innovative ideas and modern logistics techniques.

cards.heading: Pakistan’s Most Professional 3PL
cards.description: To be Pakistan’s most professional 3PL organization, built on core values, professional excellence and continuous growth. We strive to deliver superior logistics services and innovative solutions that create lasting value for our clients.

cards.heading: Customized Logistics, Built to Grow
cards.description: To expand our business frontiers by discovering new markets, building a performance-driven culture rooted in sustainability, and ensuring our clients receive customized logistics solutions, with a focus on dry cargo, oil and liquid, containerized or otherwise.
